column1: # Junctions excluded from the annotated SV table.
# EMPTY BY DESIGN. This file ships with no rows. The intervals that belong
# here are properties of this cohort, this panel and this aligner, and
# importing another study's list would exclude junctions that were never
# observed here while missing the ones that were.
# Derive the candidates from your own tables:
#   bin/derive_excluded_junctions.py \
#       --annotated results/t2t/calls/mm_annotated/*.mm_annotated.tsv \
#       --min-samples 3 --tolerance 200 \
#       --output assets/mm_excluded_junctions.proposed.tsv
# Every proposal is written commented out. Read each against the alignment,
# then move the ones you accept into this file uncommented.
# THE CRITERION IS COORDINATE IDENTITY, NOT RECURRENCE.
# Somatic breakpoints do not recur to the nucleotide between individuals:
# repair at a real junction is imprecise, so two patients sharing a
# rearrangement share the intron, not the base. Agreement to within a few
# bases across unrelated samples is a property of the reference or the
# aligner rather than of the tumours.
# Recurrence alone must never become the criterion. This disease is defined
# by recurrent events: t(11;14) appears in 15-20% of patients, t(4;14) in
# 10-15%. A list built on "seen in several samples" would exclude the panel's
# entire purpose.
# A row whose dictionary entry names it, or which carries a tier, is never
# excluded regardless of what matches here. The override lives in
# bin/annotate_mm_translocations.py and is not configurable.
# Junctions on an Ig anchor deserve particular scrutiny before being added.
# The anchor rule makes any IGH, IGK, IGL or MYC junction reportable
# whatever the partner, so an artefact on one of those loci reaches the
# report on every sample in the cohort. That is the reason a list like this
# exists at all.
# Positions are 1-based, on T2T-CHM13v2.0. TOLERANCE is the window either
# side, in bp, within which a call is treated as the same artefact. Both
# orientations are matched, so a reciprocal mate needs no separate row.
